title: Your pension account is “frozen”
scenario: A caller claiming to be from a benefits agency says unusual activity froze your pension account. They ask you to confirm your identity by reading a code sent to your phone.

answers.A: Read the code because the agency already has your phone number and sent it to you.
answers.B: End the call and sign in through the official benefits portal or call the agency using a known number.
answers.C: Ask the caller to send a notice to your online account, then verify it there.

explanation: One-time codes are frequently used to take over accounts. An incoming caller should not need the credential that unlocks your account.
proTip: If the caller needs your login code, they may be trying to become you.
